reviews.text: We're so glad you had a great experience! We’ll make sure to pass this on to our San Pedro location. Thanks for partnering with us for your pet's needs. 🐾 …

Our two dogs have been going here for a few years. On July 29, 2026, we sent Peanut here. He came back very sick with diarrhea. We took him back on Aug 3, 2026 for remedy. The hospital charged us even more for resolving the issue. We asked that Banfield cover the expense since the problem started within minutes of arriving from from Banfield on July 29. They argued that we cannot prove it.

The San Pedro Banfield is beyond 5 stars. Everyone there the staff and vets are so friendly, helpful, and respectful. Special shout out to Martha. Always attentive to your pets needs and also to you. Taking your pet to the vet can can be so stressful but they always are so attentive. The facility is very clean and usually unless they have an emergency, the wait time to get an appointment is easy and reasonable.  Soleil and I can’t thank you all enough. 💟
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡 …
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …

Love Dr Dean and the team! My dog, Bly, has been a patient for 7 years. The BANFIELD staff are welcoming at every visit. The team serves the pet parents in a professional manner and is very helpful whenever I have questions.
Everyone who works there focus on doing the best possible, in an efficient way, taking great care of the pets.

The receptionist was helpful and friendly.
The service was completed quickly.

Love this Banfield location SO much! They are beyond kind to my baby, Barney. Everytime they welcome him with so much love and attention. He loves going there! Also, their prices are fair and the vets always do the right thing and not overcharge.

The manager for this location is horrible!! She is rude, condescending, and has no customer care. Don’t trust whatever she’s doing with your contract. She’s the reason I’m trying to pull my contract with them that I’ve had for 5 years.

My cat has been going to Banfield since 2013 and overall it has been a very pleasant experience. The front office staff, Vets and Vet Technicians are thorough and caring towards my cat. They also take time to explain issues/conditions to you when necessary. I started my cat on her Optimum Wellness Plan in the beginning due to the high cost of a dental cleaning. Most cats get periodontitis, so it's important so they can eat as they get old. It is included, along with routine vaccinations and two comprehensive exams per year. Her healthcare is affordable since you can spread out routine healthcare costs over monthly payments. It is more economical than paying separately for each service/need.  The convenience of a one-stop shop matters also. Perks like 24/7 online virtual pet care, office visits, and 15% discount for whatever is not included in the plan. Costs have gone up, but my monthly premium has remained reasonable and affordable over the years. I recommend an Optimum Wellness Plan to anyone who aims to keep their pet healthy. When I moved, there was always a Banfield in the vicinity, many times inside of a PetSmart store.  When I adopt another pet, I will not hesitate to enroll her in an Optimum Wellness Plan with Banfield.
We're thrilled that you and your pet had a positive experience with us. Thanks for sharing your review!
Lady Einstein and I had a great visit at the Banfield Pet Hospital.The Doctors and Staff were efficient, helpful and friendly .

Banfield San Pedro is a wonderful place to bring your animals! All of the staff are amazing and so kind! My cats enjoy going to vet here and always leave in a good mood even when they are going in not feeling well. So lucky to have found them! Very transparent with pricing and options for your animals. They have great options outside of pet insurance with their wellness plans, too! We usually see Dr. Polcari, but when she is not there we always have great experiences with every Dr. !

Hi EM, our aim is to provide a positive experience to everyone coming to our hospitals. We understand you were not satisfied and would like to follow up on your experience with us. Please reach out to our Client Advocate Team at BanfieldCares@banfield.com at your convenience so we can try to address your concerns.

I feel like Banfield needs to be communicative about there plans for the pets because I know certain things are covered by the plan but when things are coming up such as shot's, physical's, and stuff that are important for your pet they at least give you a courtesy call. If the plan states you only get a certain amounts of days to take them to get seen they should inform you about that too, but I feel like only certain people they choose to do those things and I pay a good amount of money for my dogs plan but I most likely not be renewing with them.
If your pet needs surgery, they ship you off to way more expensive service

My Banfield of San Pedro treat my baby like a Princess. She’s always happy to see staff. Gives them all kisses. Even in the worse of moments, they have always had space and given her the attention she needs. I love these folks.

My favorite location. Although it's part of the Banfield brand, this location feels like a neighborhood vet. It's always clean and they are friendly and knowledgeable. I also like that if I need a quick allergy shot for my pup, they squeeze him in if they can. Just great all around. thank you team :-)

I love coming here! The staff is friendly and polite. You can tell they like the pets.

Environment always clean, easy to park, great hours, also the pet plan is ABSOLUTELY worth it. Unlimited visits, are you kidding me? I love this!!

We have been using Banfield for several years, several doggies.  They always fix the problems, the staff is friendly and the price is comparable to other vets we have used  - the entire facility is very clean and the doctors are knowledgeable - 5 stars from our family!
Thanks for the pawsitive review!
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF 🧡 We appreciate the review! …
Great clinic, they helped a lot with our dog teeth situation. It's so much better now! Thank you 🙂 …
Thanks for the 5 stars and for partnering with us for your pet’s health!
Staff were super nice clean they were all helpful first time there and I actually liked it I recommend any person with a big dog to go they were very nice handled my baby with care

This is the worst experience I've ever had with an animal hospital.
I visited this hospital to obtain a Health Certificate for traveling to Japan. I paid all the fees for the USDA endorsement, and the doctor told me that all the paperwork had been submitted through their system. However, all the subsequent instructions were wrong, and when I contacted the USDA office, I was told the fees had not been paid, the certification  had not been submitted at all, and the information on the documentations was incorrect.

I had to redo everything at a different hospital. This is fraud.
I believe this is completely unprofessional and unacceptable for an accredited veterinarian.

The hospital's response afterward was also terrible.

I will never go to this hospital again.
I am leaving this review in hopes that no one else will have to go through the same experience.
I wasted $930 and 7 days.

I love this place. They always treat my kitty with such care. They know me and my boy as soon as we come in. We first went to them when my aging Cocker Spaniel needed attention and they were incredibly sweet about tending to him. This has been a wonderful vet and they are fair with their services. We did subscribe to their monthly pet insurance and it's really saved us a lot. Highly recommend this vet for your animals.

Banfield BEFORE covid was amazing. This company now steals money from you when on their insurance. They up prices then give you a ‘discount’ to make it seem like you’re getting a deal. Please don’t sign up for their insurance wellness plan. IT IS NOT WORTH THE MONEY THEY TAKE FROM YOU!! my pets wellness means everything to me which is why I stayed on the plan for as long as I did. Don’t make the same mistake I did.

Also - dropping off my pet for an appointment they have is ridiculous to me! They are left in cages for hours. Before covid we were able to go with our pets, meet the vet that was treating my dog. I mean cmon, would you drop your child off at their doctors office and leave them there for hours!? No thanks. I don’t know what’s happening to my dogs when leaving them there and you hear horror stories about your pets being mistreated. No thank you. After being a loyal customer (naive and stupid too) since 2016 I am done.
You've got us purring with your 4-star rating! 😺 Thank you for choosing Banfield.  …

I would not recommend any Banfield service at all.  This particular location did not care about my cat who has kidney disease and hyperthyroidism.  I never could speak to a vet, the nurses acted like doctors taking messages back and forth and I could never get a doctor to answer questions about my cats health.  They never answer their phones and they claim that they are short staffed in veterinarians claiming that calling an on call vet was too expensive.  For the monthly amount I paid and others have paid, they could afford it.  Numerous times, they closed without telling me because they didn’t have a vet that day and my appointments were canceled. But I finally cancelled my subscription and took my baby to a private vet.  Not only was I treated with respect and spoke to a vet but I was given proper recommendations for proper care for my cat.  To top it all off, when I took my cat to the vet, she had an ear infection - why couldn’t Banfield see that?  I have been in and out several times this past month. Run from this hospital as fast as you can.
Bandfailed!!!! Run save your dog. O stars. If you want a big corporate veterinary please do yourself a favor. Run. These people don’t care. They are Corporate! …
Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕  …

Had a 2pm scheduled appointment and they called 1 hour beforehand and canceled it.  Planned my whole Saturday around it.  Completely unacceptable and not professional whatsoever.   Go somewhere else. if thats the way they treat people,  what will they do to your pet.
They treat my dog great. Great place and I’ve been to a couple of bandfields and vets. This one has been the best for my boy Kal-El
Front desk lies and they never have available appointments

I thank all staff to take care of my furbabies,  due to move far away I can't continue but  we never know, I liked they saw my cat on Sundays.
Thank You
